messages:
maya: quick non-work drop — meet Juniper, my ferret, modeling her new sock. GIF: https://imgur.com/a/JuniperSockShow :heart_eyes:
tom: omg that tiny strut :rofl:
jess: the little pirouette at 0:03 melted me :sob: :chef-kiss:
arjun: how do you get a ferret to tolerate a sock tho? :thinking:
maya: bribery. peanut butter + a quiet box. also just gentle introductions over a week. harness helps for photos. :ok_hand:
leah: are ferrets allowed in the office? asking for purely scientific reasons :eyes:
maya: only on scheduled "bring-your-pet" meetups and with updated shots + registered at ops. (Juniper is virtual today) :grin:
milo-bot: Reminder: Office pets policy and registration form: https://redwood.example.com/pets-policy :information_source:
tom: can you post a still? my laptop blocks gifs at work :grimacing:
maya: uploaded photo: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F54321/juniper_sock.jpg
jess: saving as wallpaper immediately. Juniper's name is iconic btw :heart:
arjun: naming suggestion: "Socktopus" :joy:
maya: absolute nonsense, but I love the energy. also someone called her "Slinker" yesterday :smile:
leah: tiny poll — react with :one: for Juniper, :two: for Socktopus
(reactions: tom :one:, jess :one:, arjun :two:)
tom: :one: (Juniper forever)
jess: :one: 100%
arjun: :two: for chaos
milo-bot: (automated) Poll results: Juniper 2, Socktopus 1, Abstain 0
jess: also — drop other critter pics for Friday's micro-break? camera_with_flash
maya: will post more tomorrow (juniper doing a dramatic flop) :wave:
